verdict_reason: Removing the OIDC mock is safe (the suite runs in stub mode, where the auth plugin never fetches discovery), but the inline server start/stop duplicates the shared startTestServer/stopTestServer helpers.

todos.issue: The test starts and stops its own server inline (lines 11-18: createServer(), server.initialize(), server.stop({ timeout: 0 })) beside the shared helpers that already own exactly that in common/test-helpers/test-server.js: 'export async function startTestServer() { const server = await createServer(); await server.initialize(); ... }' and 'stopTestServer(server)'.
todos.fix: Must: this test's server lifecycle goes through the shared test-server helpers, with no inline copy. One way: beforeAll(async () => { server = await startTestServer() }) and afterAll(() => stopTestServer(server)), dropping the createServer import.
